# GitHub Copilot instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and [.specify/memory/constitution.md](../.specify/memory/constitution.md) before modifying code. Read the relevant feature specification, technical plan and tasks as well.

All source code, comments, identifiers, technical documentation, branches and commits MUST be English. UI text belongs in localization resources. Respect feature boundaries, dependency direction, strict TypeScript and nullable C# conventions. Prefer simple, testable implementations; never silence errors, fabricate results or introduce unused dependencies.

The repository is public. Never insert credentials, real visitor transcripts, private prompts, unpublished biography or proprietary code. The server owns security, conversation state and access to approved knowledge. Expose only safe structured decision events, never hidden reasoning.

Add or update appropriate tests. Run available formatting, lint, type, build and test commands and report failures or unavailable checks. Do not bypass checks or merge without owner approval. Do not implement features before their approved specification and plan.
